scientific_integrity: All determinant enumeration is exact in Z[sqrt(2)], complete on 10626 vertex quadruples. Convexity of absolute affine determinants extends sharp bound to arbitrary points. No independent audit or external certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Fixed three-dimensional regular small rhombicuboctahedron only; 48 counts only vertex-supported maximizers. Sixteen movable-apex families are exhibited, not claimed exhaustive among all nonvertex maximizers. Historical priority is provisional; exact enumeration should receive independent inspection.
title: Largest tetrahedra and sixteen movable-apex families in the rhombicuboctahedron
